extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I searched every emitted report line and every workflow string for a selected or supporting rate whose denominator equals the retained count of 72 while the claim scope is the full network. The only rate emitted is 18/96, the denominator sentence names all 96 scheduled stations, and the limitations section explicitly states no screened-subset rate is reported. I also checked whether the 72 value is used arithmetically in analysis.py; it appears only in the descriptive PASSED_LINE (L0018), never as a divisor. The in-scope mismatch therefore cannot be demonstrated.
